sloka: तम् रथम् सूर्य सम्काशम् सीता हृष्टेन चेतसा ।आरुरोह वर आरोहा कृत्वा अलम्कारम् आत्मनः ॥२-४०-१३॥
transliteration: tam ratham sūrya samkāśam sītā hṛṣṭena cetasā ।āruroha vara ārohā kṛtvā alamkāram ātmanaḥ ॥2-40-13॥

translations.english: Sita of lovely limbs decorated herself and with a cheerful mind boarded the chariot which was shining like the Sun.
